en: Black‑and‑white view of a large Gothic church with a massive square tower surmounted by a multi‑tiered Baroque spire. In front of the side façade there is a landscaped square with small trees and flowerbeds, as well as a statue on a pedestal standing between two small turreted chapel‑like structures. Residential buildings with steep roofs appear in the background. The image has rough white masking around the tower area and handwritten numbers along the bottom border, suggesting an old photographic postcard or plate.
